d:
A humanoid scorpion creature with a hard, obsidian black exoskeleton and a segmented torso. Small, glowing yellow eyes set into a chitinous face. Lean, insectoid build with two large, curved pincers for hands. A long, segmented, curved stinger tail of obsidian black and two small, translucent wings of dark grey. Three pointed claws on each hand.
BODY COLOR: obsidian black
